name: Oshi no Hanaya ni Deaimashita!!
original_name: 推しの花屋に出会いました！！
source:
While walking your dog, you encounter a lost florist!?
He's good-looking, but has an extremely poor sense of direction.
A fun interaction game in which you interact with a slightly clumsy florist.
[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/osi.html]official website[/url]]
